summary: Enhance your mediation and negotiation skills with our specialized training focused on UNSCR 1325. Empower yourself to make a difference in conflict resolution
lede: Mediation and negotiation training focused on UNSCR 1325 is for practitioners working in conflict, dialogue, peacebuilding, or negotiation. It covers conflict and stakeholder analysis, identifying power dynamics and gender-related participation barriers, and preparing interest-based negotiations. Participants also practise inclusive facilitation, managing caucuses, and drafting agreements and follow-up records for multi-party dialogue.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who already work around conflict, dialogue, peacebuilding, or negotiation and need a more disciplined approach to mediation. You should see yourself in roles that involve preparing talks, facilitating difficult conversations, documenting commitments, or advising leaders on contentious issues.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for template-based exercises and a willingness to work through role-plays, case notes, and scenario planning. Participants benefit most if they can relate the exercises to an actual mediation, negotiation, or dialogue challenge from their own work.
